description: Topic taxonomy + Speaking question bank + Final Practice presets. Sửa file này rồi npm run build để reflect vào app.

answerFrames: My name is…
My full name is…
self.tip: Tên thường dùng + and + full name.
self.sampleAnswer: My name is Khanh, and my full name is Trinh Bao Khanh.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz Khanh, ənd maɪ fʊl ˈneɪm ɪz Trinh Bao Khanh/

self.q: How do you spell your name?
self.audioFile: 02 - How do you spell your name.wav
answerFrames: K-H-A-N-H.
Sure, it is spelt K-H-A-N-H.
self.tip: Đọc rõ từng chữ cái, chậm và tách nhau.
sampleAnswerIpa: /keɪ - eɪtʃ - eɪ - en - eɪtʃ/

answerFrames: I am … years old.
and I was born in…
self.tip: Tuổi + and + năm sinh (sự thật nên dùng and, không cần because).
self.sampleAnswer: I am twenty-five years old, and I was born in 2001.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ əm ˈtwenti faɪv jɪəz əʊld, ənd aɪ wəz bɔːn ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd wʌn/

answerFrames: My birthday is on…
on the … of …
self.tip: on + the + ngày thứ tự + of + tháng.
self.sampleAnswer: My birthday is on the thirteenth of June, two thousand and one.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈbɜːθdeɪ ɪz ɒn ðə ˌθɜːˈtiːnθ əv dʒuːn, tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd wʌn/

hometown.q: Where do you come from? / Where are you from?
answerFrames: I come from… / I'm from…
I was born and raised in…
It's in Central Vietnam.
hometown.tip: Nơi + and + vùng miền (sự thật nên dùng and).
hometown.sampleAnswer: I come from Thanh Hoa, and it is in the north-central part of Vietnam.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ kʌm frəm Thanh Hoa, ənd ɪt ɪz ɪn ðə ˌnɔːθ ˈsentrəl pɑːt əv ˌvjetˈnæm/

hometown.q: What do you like about your hometown?
answerFrames: What I like about my hometown is (that)…
The good thing is…
The people are very friendly, and the food is very delicious.
hometown.tip: Frame + 2 điều thích → câu 2 giải thích từng điều.
hometown.sampleAnswer: What I like about my hometown is the people and the food. The people are very friendly, and the food is very delicious.
sampleAnswerIpa: /wɒt aɪ laɪk əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈhəʊmtaʊn ɪz ðə ˈpiːpl ənd ðə fuːd/
/ðə ˈpiːpl ə ˈveri ˈfrendli, ənd ðə fuːd ɪz ˈveri dɪˈlɪʃəs/

hometown.q: Is there anything you dislike about your hometown? / What do you dislike about your hometown?
answerFrames: What I don't like about my hometown is (that)…
The trouble is…
The weather isn't very great.
hometown.sampleAnswer: What I don't like about my hometown is the weather, because it is very hot in the summer.
sampleAnswerIpa: /wɒt aɪ dəʊnt ˈlaɪk əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈhəʊmtaʊn ɪz ðə ˈweðə, bɪˈkəz ɪt ɪz ˈveri hɒt ɪn ðə ˈsʌmə/

hometown.q: Are there any lakes or rivers in your hometown?
answerFrames: Yes, there is the … River in my hometown.
It is very long and beautiful.
The water is crystal clear.
hometown.tip: Yes + There is + tên sông + câu 2 tả bằng tính từ.
hometown.sampleAnswer: Yes, there is the Ma River in my hometown. It is very long and beautiful.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes, ðər ɪz ðə Ma ˈrɪvər ɪn maɪ ˈhəʊmtaʊn/
/ɪt ɪz ˈveri lɒŋ ənd ˈbjuːtɪfl/

hometown.q: Are there any woods or forests in your hometown?
answerFrames: Yes, there is … National Park near my hometown.
It is big / huge / vast and beautiful.
It has many kinds of plants, and the air there is cool and fresh.
hometown.tip: Yes + There is + tên rừng / công viên + câu 2 tả bằng tính từ.
hometown.sampleAnswer: Yes, there is Cuc Phuong National Park near my hometown. It is big and beautiful.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes, ðər ɪz Cuc Phuong ˈnæʃnəl pɑːk nɪə maɪ ˈhəʊmtaʊn/
/ɪt ɪz bɪɡ ənd ˈbjuːtɪfl/

hometown.q: Are there any hills or mountains in your hometown?
answerFrames: Yes, there is … Mountain in my hometown.
It is high / enormous / rocky and beautiful.
People go hiking / go climbing there.
hometown.tip: Yes + There is + tên núi + câu 2 tả bằng tính từ.
hometown.sampleAnswer: Yes, there is Ham Rong Mountain in my hometown. It is high and beautiful.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes, ðər ɪz Ham Rong ˈmaʊntɪn ɪn maɪ ˈhəʊmtaʊn/
/ɪt ɪz haɪ ənd ˈbjuːtɪfl/

job.q: What do you do? / What is your job?
answerFrames: I'm a/an… at…
I'm working as a/an… at…
I develop web applications for businesses.
job.tip: Nghề + at + nơi làm + and + việc chính.
job.sampleAnswer: I am a software developer at FPT IS, and I develop web applications for businesses.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ əm ə ˈsɒftweə dɪˈveləpər ət FPT IS, ənd aɪ dɪˈveləp web ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃnz fə ˈbɪznəsɪz/

job.q: Are you a student or are you working?
job.audioFile: 07 - Are you a student or are you working.wav
answerFrames: I'm working. I'm a/an… at…
I'm a student at…
job.tip: Chọn working / studying + and + nghề (sự thật, không cần because).
job.sampleAnswer: I am working, and I am a software developer at FPT IS.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ əm ˈwɜːkɪŋ, ənd aɪ əm ə ˈsɒftweə dɪˈveləpər ət FPT IS/

job.q: What is your dream job? Why?
job.audioFile: 08 - What is your dream job - why.wav
answerFrames: My dream is to become a/an… at…
It's a good job for me because…
It's a well-paid job.
job.tip: Dream job + at + nơi làm + because + 1 lý do.
job.sampleAnswer: My dream is to become a senior developer at an international company, because I want to earn more money.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ driːm ɪz tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈsiːniə dɪˈveləpər ət ən ˌɪntəˈnæʃnəl ˈkʌmpəni, bɪˈkəz aɪ wɒnt tʊ ɜːn mɔː ˈmʌni/

hobbies.q: What do you often do in your free time?
hobbies.audioFile: 09 - What do you often do in your free time.wav
answerFrames: I often + Verb…
I'm really into / keen on…
It helps me stay healthy and reduce stress.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: I often hit the gym in my free time, because it helps me stay healthy and reduce stress.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈɒfn hɪt ðə dʒɪm ɪn maɪ friː ˈtaɪm, bɪˈkəz ɪt helps mi steɪ ˈhelθi ənd rɪˈdjuːs stres/

hobbies.q: What do you often do on the weekend?
hobbies.audioFile: 10 - What do you often do at the weekend.wav
answerFrames: At the weekend, I often…
It helps me stay healthy and relax.
I often go out for drinks with my friends.
hobbies.tip: At the weekend + hoạt động + because + lợi ích.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: At the weekend, I often play badminton, because it helps me stay healthy and relax.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ət ðə ˌwiːkˈend, aɪ ˈɒfn pleɪ ˈbædmɪntən, bɪˈkəz ɪt helps mi steɪ ˈhelθi ənd rɪˈlæks/

hobbies.q: Do you like sports? How often?
hobbies.audioFile: 11 - Do you like sports - how often.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I play badminton with my friends about once a week.
It helps me stay healthy and relax.
It helps me keep in shape.
hobbies.tip: Yes + môn + tần suất + because + lợi ích.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, I play badminton with my friends about once a week, because it helps me stay healthy and relax.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes, aɪ pleɪ ˈbædmɪntən wɪð maɪ frendz əˈbaʊt wʌns ə wiːk, bɪˈkəz ɪt helps mi steɪ ˈhelθi ənd rɪˈlæks/

answerFrames: No, I don't, because I like hanging out with my friends.
We play sports and eat together.
I often spend my free time hanging out with my friends.
hobbies.tip: No, I don't + because + việc thích hơn → câu 2 nói rõ làm gì.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: No, I don't, because I like hanging out with my friends. We play sports and eat together.
sampleAnswerIpa: /nəʊ, aɪ dəʊnt, bɪˈkəz aɪ laɪk ˈhæŋɪŋ aʊt wɪð maɪ frendz/
/wi pleɪ spɔːts ənd iːt təˈɡeðə/

hobbies.q: What kinds of movies do you like?
hobbies.audioFile: 13 - What kinds of films do you like.wav
answerFrames: I don't really watch films.
I like comedy / action / romantic films because…
hobbies.tip: Đây là câu Wh-, KHÔNG trả lời "No, I don't". Nói "I don't really watch films" + because.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: I don't really watch films, because I like hanging out with my friends.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ dəʊnt ˈrɪəli wɒtʃ fɪlmz, bɪˈkəz aɪ laɪk ˈhæŋɪŋ aʊt wɪð maɪ frendz/

answerFrames: I don't have a favourite film.
My favourite film is…
hobbies.tip: Đây là câu Wh-, KHÔNG trả lời "No, I don't". Nói "I don't have a favourite film" + because.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: I don't have a favourite film, because I prefer hanging out with my friends.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ dəʊnt həv ə ˈfeɪvərɪt fɪlm, bɪˈkəz aɪ prɪˈfɜː ˈhæŋɪŋ aʊt wɪð maɪ frendz/

hobbies.audioFile: 16 - Do you like reading books - what do you like reading most.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I like reading books about technology and software development.
I'm really into / interested in reading books about…
They help me improve my knowledge and skills.
hobbies.tip: Yes + chủ đề sách → câu 2 nói lợi ích.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, I like reading books about technology and software development. They help me improve my knowledge and skills.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes, aɪ laɪk ˈriːdɪŋ bʊks əˈbaʊt tekˈnɒlədʒi ənd ˈsɒftweə dɪˈveləpmənt/
/ðeɪ help mi ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈnɒlɪdʒ ənd skɪlz/

hobbies.q: Do you like listening to music?
hobbies.audioFile: 17 - Do you like listening to music - what kind of music do you often listen to.wav
answerFrames: I often listen to Vietnamese music and remix music.
I usually listen to music when I work or hit the gym.
It helps me relax.
hobbies.tip: Loại nhạc + khi nào nghe + because + lợi ích.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: I often listen to Vietnamese music and remix music when I work or hit the gym, because it helps me relax.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈɒfn ˈlɪsn tə ˌvjetnəˈmiːz ˈmjuːzɪk ənd ˈriːmɪks ˈmjuːzɪk wen aɪ wɜːk ɔː hɪt ðə dʒɪm, bɪˈkəz ɪt helps mi rɪˈlæks/

hobbies.audioFile: 18 - Do you like playing computer games - what is your favourite computer game.wav
answerFrames: Yes, but not very often.
My favourite computer game is League of Legends.
We are all working now, so we don't play games very often.
hobbies.tip: Yes, but not very often → tên game → so + lý do ít chơi.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, but not very often. My favourite computer game is League of Legends. We are all working now, so we don't play games very often.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes, bət nɒt ˈveri ˈɒfn/
/maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt kəmˈpjuːtə ɡeɪm ɪz liːɡ əv ˈledʒəndz/
/wi ɑːr ɔːl ˈwɜːkɪŋ naʊ, səʊ wi dəʊnt pleɪ ɡeɪmz ˈveri ˈɒfn/

daily-routine.q: What time is it in your country?
daily-routine.audioFile: 19 - What time is it in your country.wav
answerFrames: It is … o'clock.
It is half past …
It is quarter past / quarter to …
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: It is half past seven in the morning, so people are going to work now.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ɪt ɪz hɑːf pɑːst ˈsevn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ, səʊ ˈpiːpl ə ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə wɜːk naʊ/

daily-routine.q: What time do you get up?
daily-routine.audioFile: 20 - What time do you get up.wav
answerFrames: I usually get up at … in the morning.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I usually get up at seven in the morning, because I start work at eight.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡet ʌp ət ˈsevn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ, bɪˈkəz aɪ stɑːt wɜːk ət eɪt/

daily-routine.q: What time do you go to work?
answerFrames: I go to work at…
I leave home at…
daily-routine.tip: go to work at + giờ + and + 1 chi tiết.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I go to work at eight in the morning, and it takes me twenty minutes.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ɡəʊ tə wɜːk ət eɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ, ənd ɪt teɪks mi ˈtwenti ˈmɪnɪts/

daily-routine.q: What time do you have breakfast?
daily-routine.audioFile: 22 - What time do you have breakfast.wav
answerFrames: I have breakfast at…
I usually have breakfast at home.
daily-routine.tip: have breakfast at + giờ + ở đâu.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I have breakfast at half past seven, usually at home before I go to work.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ həv ˈbrekfəst ət hɑːf pɑːst ˈsevn, ˈjuːʒuəli ət həʊm bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ɡəʊ tə wɜːk/

daily-routine.q: What time do you have lunch?
answerFrames: I have lunch at…
I have lunch with my colleagues.
daily-routine.tip: have lunch at + giờ + and + với ai.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I have lunch at half past twelve, and I usually eat with my colleagues.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ həv lʌntʃ ət hɑːf pɑːst twelv, ənd aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli iːt wɪð maɪ ˈkɒliːɡz/

daily-routine.q: What time do you have dinner?
answerFrames: I have dinner at…
I have dinner with my family.
daily-routine.tip: have dinner at + giờ + and + ở đâu / với ai.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I have dinner at about seven in the evening, and I usually eat at home.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ həv ˈdɪnər ət əˈbaʊt ˈsevn ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ, ənd aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli iːt ət həʊm/

daily-routine.q: What time do you come home from work?
answerFrames: I come home at / around … in the evening.
daily-routine.tip: come home at + giờ + and then + việc tiếp theo.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I usually come home at six in the evening, and then I go to the gym.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli kʌm həʊm ət sɪks ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ, ənd ðen aɪ ɡəʊ tə ðə dʒɪm/

daily-routine.q: What time do you go to bed?
daily-routine.audioFile: 26 - What time do you go to bed.wav
answerFrames: I go to bed at about … at night.
daily-routine.tip: go to bed at + giờ + because.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I go to bed at about eleven at night, because I have to get up early.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ɡəʊ tə bed ət əˈbaʊt ɪˈlevn ət naɪt, bɪˈkəz aɪ hæv tə ɡet ʌp ˈɜːli/

daily-routine.q: How do you go to work?
answerFrames: I go to work by motorbike / bus / bike.
I walk because it is near my house.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I usually go to work by motorbike, because it is faster than the bus.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡəʊ tə wɜːk baɪ ˈməʊtəbaɪk, bɪˈkəz ɪt ɪz ˈfɑːstə ðən ðə bʌs/

daily-routine.q: How often do you phone your friend?
daily-routine.audioFile: 28 - How often do you phone your friend.wav
answerFrames: I call my friend once / twice a week.
I often chat with my friends online.
We usually make plans to go out for drinks or play badminton.
daily-routine.tip: Tần suất + because + lý do gọi / chat.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I often chat with my friends online, because we make plans to go out for drinks.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈɒfn tʃæt wɪð maɪ frendz ˈɒnlaɪn, bɪˈkəz wi meɪk plænz tə ɡəʊ aʊt fə drɪŋks/

daily-routine.q: How often do you clean the house?
answerFrames: I clean the house every day / once a week.
I always keep things tidy.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I clean the house almost every day, because I like a clean and tidy home.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ kliːn ðə haʊs ˈɔːlməʊst ˈevri deɪ, bɪˈkəz aɪ laɪk ə kliːn ənd ˈtaɪdi həʊm/

daily-routine.q: How often do you read the newspaper?
answerFrames: I never read newspapers.
I rarely read newspapers.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I never read newspapers, because I usually get the news on my phone.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈnevə riːd ˈnjuːzpeɪpəz, bɪˈkəz aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡet ðə njuːz ɒn maɪ fəʊn/

daily-routine.q: How often do you have friends round? (When you have friends round, what do you like to do?)
daily-routine.audioFile: 29 - How often do you have friends round - what do you like to do.wav
answerFrames: When I have friends round, we usually…
We usually play games, drink beer and talk together.
daily-routine.tip: When I have friends round + hoạt động + because.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: When I have friends round, we usually play games and drink beer, because it is relaxing.
sampleAnswerIpa: /wen aɪ həv frendz ˈraʊnd, wi ˈjuːʒuəli pleɪ ɡeɪmz ənd drɪŋk bɪə, bɪˈkəz ɪt ɪz rɪˈlæksɪŋ/

family.q: Do you live in a big family?
family.audioFile: 30 - Do you live in a big family.wav
answerFrames: No, I live in a small family with my parents and my younger sister.
Yes, I come from quite a big family.
family.tip: Big / small + with + các thành viên.
family.sampleAnswer: No, I live in a small family with my parents, my younger sister and me.
sampleAnswerIpa: /nəʊ, aɪ lɪv ɪn ə smɔːl ˈfæməli wɪð maɪ ˈpeərənts, maɪ ˈjʌŋɡə ˈsɪstər ənd miː/

answerFrames: My father is a/an…
He works as a/an…
He runs a…
family.tip: Nghề + and + chi tiết (sự thật nên dùng and).
family.sampleAnswer: My father is a tailor, and he runs a tailor shop with my mother.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðər ɪz ə ˈteɪlə, ənd hi rʌnz ə ˈteɪlə ʃɒp wɪð maɪ ˈmʌðə/

answerFrames: My mother is a/an…
She works as a/an…
She works with my father at…
family.sampleAnswer: My mother is a tailor too, and she works with my father at their shop.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈmʌðər ɪz ə ˈteɪlə tuː, ənd ʃi wɜːks wɪð maɪ ˈfɑːðər ət ðeə ʃɒp/

answerFrames: He is really into…
He likes…
It helps him relax.
family.sampleAnswer: My father likes gardening in his free time, because it helps him relax.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðə laɪks ˈɡɑːdnɪŋ ɪn hɪz friː ˈtaɪm, bɪˈkəz ɪt helps hɪm rɪˈlæks/

answerFrames: She is really into…
She likes…
It helps her keep in shape.
family.tip: Nhớ thêm 's': she likes. Rồi + because.
family.sampleAnswer: My mother likes walking for exercise, because it helps her keep in shape.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈmʌðə laɪks ˈwɔːkɪŋ fər ˈeksəsaɪz, bɪˈkəz ɪt helps hə kiːp ɪn ʃeɪp/

appearance.q: What does your father look like?
answerFrames: He is about fifty.
He is about 169 centimetres tall.
He has got short black hair with some grey hair.
appearance.tip: Age + height + hair, nối bằng and.
appearance.sampleAnswer: My father is about fifty, and he is about 169 centimetres tall with short black hair.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðər ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈfɪfti, ənd hi ɪz əˈbaʊt wʌn ˈsɪksti naɪn ˈsentɪmiːtəz tɔːl wɪð ʃɔːt blæk heə/

appearance.q: What does your mother look like?
answerFrames: She is forty-six years old.
She is about 162 centimetres tall.
She is quite slim.
appearance.tip: Age + height + build. Nữ dùng pretty / good-looking, không dùng handsome.
appearance.sampleAnswer: My mother is forty-six, and she is about 162 centimetres tall and quite slim.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈmʌðər ɪz ˈfɔːti sɪks, ənd ʃi ɪz əˈbaʊt wʌn ˈsɪksti tuː ˈsentɪmiːtəz tɔːl ənd kwaɪt slɪm/

appearance.q: What kind of hair does your father have?
answerFrames: He has got short black hair.
He has got short black hair with some grey hair.
appearance.tip: Độ dài + màu tóc, dùng "has got".
appearance.sampleAnswer: He has got short black hair, and there is some grey hair now.
sampleAnswerIpa: /hi həz ɡɒt ʃɔːt blæk heə, ənd ðər ɪz səm ɡreɪ heə naʊ/

appearance.q: What kind of hair does your mother have?

personality.q: Is your mother friendly, talkative, humorous or generous?

personality.tip: Không cần trả lời hết 4 tính từ, chọn 1–2 + because.

answerFrames: There is a fridge, a gas cooker and a sink.

answerFrames: Yes, definitely, because…

relax / learn new things / gain new experience

trip.sampleAnswer: Yes, definitely, because I can relax, see new places and gain new experience.

trip.q: Tell me about one trip you remember the most.
trip.audioFile: 41 - Tell me about one trip you remember the most.wav
answerFrames: 1. Nơi: The trip I remember the most is the trip to…
2. Khi nào: I went there … ago.
3. Đi với ai: I went with my family / friends / girlfriend.
4. Đi bằng gì: We went there by car / train / plane, and it took us about…
5. Làm gì: We did a lot of things there: we went sightseeing, we enjoyed the local food, we went swimming…
6. Cảm nhận: It was great / wonderful / fantastic. I had a terrific time.
trip.tip: Dạng kể — 6 câu ngắn theo đúng thứ tự: nơi → khi nào → với ai → bằng gì → làm gì → cảm nhận.
trip.sampleAnswer: The trip I remember the most is the trip to Nha Trang. I went there about six months ago. I went with my girlfriend. We went there by plane, and it took us about two hours. We did a lot of things there: we went sightseeing, we went swimming, and we enjoyed the fresh seafood. It was wonderful, and I had a terrific time.

/ɪt wəz ˈwʌndəfl, ənd aɪ həd ə təˈrɪfɪk ˈtaɪm/

trip.q: Tell me about one trip you want to take in the future.
trip.audioFile: 42 - Tell me about one trip you want to take in the future.wav
answerFrames: 1. Nơi: I am going to visit…
2. Vì sao: I want to go there because I like its…
3. Đi với ai: I am going to go with…
4. Đi bằng gì: We are going to travel from … to … by train.
5. Ở đâu: We are going to stay at a small cosy hotel near a lake.
6. Làm gì: We are going to walk around the towns, take a lot of photos and try local food.
7. Cảm nhận: I think it will be an amazing experience.
trip.tip: Dạng kể tương lai — dùng "be going to": nơi → vì sao → với ai → bằng gì → ở đâu → làm gì → cảm nhận.
trip.sampleAnswer: I am going to visit Switzerland. I want to go there because I like its high mountains, clear lakes and peaceful small towns. I am going to go with my girlfriend. We are going to travel from Germany to Switzerland by train. We are going to stay at a small cosy hotel near a lake. We are going to walk around the towns, take a lot of photos and try local food. I think it will be an amazing experience.

food-restaurant.q: Do you like eating out? How often do you go to a restaurant?
food-restaurant.audioFile: 44 - Do you like eating out - how often do you go to a restaurant.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do. I go to a restaurant about once a week.
Nhà hàng nào, ở đâu: The restaurant I remember the most is a seafood restaurant in… It was a famous restaurant near my hotel.
Order gì: To start the meal, we had… For the main dishes, we had… For dessert, we had…
Nhận xét: The food was very good and delicious. The staff were friendly, and the service was fast.
Giá + kết: It was very cheap. I would definitely go there again.
food-restaurant.tip: Theo bài mẫu của bạn: Yes + tần suất → nhà hàng nào & ở đâu → order gì → nhận xét → giá & kết.
food-restaurant.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do, and I usually eat out about once a week. The restaurant I remember the most is a seafood restaurant in Nha Trang. I went there on my recent trip, and it was a famous restaurant near my hotel. To start the meal, we had crab soup. For the main dishes, we had steamed lobster, grilled oysters and steamed squid. I also chose the seafood myself, so it was very fresh. The food was very good and delicious, the staff were friendly, and the service was fast. For dessert, we had ice cream. The seafood was also very cheap, and the meal for two people was only about one million VND. I would definitely go there again.

health-illness.q: Do you exercise? What exercise do you do?
answerFrames: Yes, I go to the gym / play badminton.
It helps me keep in shape.
four or five times a week

health-illness.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do, because I go to the gym four or five times a week.

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have a headache?
answerFrames: I often rest and take aspirin.

health-illness.sampleAnswer: If I have a headache, I often rest and take some aspirin, and I stop using the computer.

health-illness.sampleAnswer: If I have got a cold, I often rest and go to bed with a hot drink.
